title: Output bit work identity
statement: For every pair of natural numbers $\ell$ and $j$, the work required for output bit $j$ equals $\ell+(j+1)(M(\ell)+1)+2\ell+1$, where $M(\ell)$ is the work for one binary modular multiplication.
